description: 경상남도 양산시_방범용 CCTV 교통량조사(노포사송로) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상남도 양산시. 양산시 통합관제센터의 방범용 CCTV 자료를 기준으로 분석한 도로교통량 공공데이터로양산 동면 사송지구 준공 전후 교통량 분석을 위해 개방되는 자료입니다. Coverage: 경상남도 양산시. The portal files it under the publisher 경상남도 양산시. Its tags are 딥러닝, 교통량, 노포사송로, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-12-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
